product_metadata.title: Comfort Zone CZHTV9 400/800-Watt Oscillating Flat Panel Halogen Infrared Portable Heater, 7-Degree Oscillation, Adjustable Tilt, Overheat Sensor, Safety Tip-Over Switch, & Stay-Cool Housing, Black
features: ☀️EFFICIENT RADIANT HEAT: Designed for small rooms, this space heater utilizes radiant heating technology to deliver instant warmth to objects and individuals directly in its path. With its focused heat output, it is an excellent option for keeping cozy in offices and bedrooms, ensuring quick and efficient heating where you need it most.

☀️SLEEK AND SPACE-SAVING: With its slimline flat panel design, this heater effortlessly fits into smaller spaces, making it an ideal choice for rooms with limited floor space. Its sleek black finish adds a touch of elegance and seamlessly complements various décor styles, enhancing the aesthetic appeal of any room.

☀️WIDE COVERAGE WITH OSCILLATION: The radiant heater is equipped with an oscillating function, allowing it to distribute warmth across a wider area. With a 70-degree oscillation range, it effectively spreads heat throughout the room, ensuring comfortable temperatures even in larger spaces. This feature is available in both high and low speed settings, providing versatile heating options based on your needs.

☀️USER-FRIENDLY CONTROL OPTIONS: With a convenient top-mounted control knob, operating the halogen heater is a breeze. You can effortlessly switch between the two heat settings and toggle the oscillation function on and off with ease. The intuitive controls make it simple to customize your heating experience according to your preferences and comfort level.

☀️ENHANCED SAFETY MEASURES: This radiant heater is equipped with a range of smart safety features to ensure your peace of mind. The stay-cool molded handle allows for safe and easy transportation, while the durable plastic housing adds an extra layer of protection. The tip-over switch automatically shuts off the heater if it gets knocked over, preventing accidents. Additionally, the overheat protection system ensures that the heater automatically turns off if it reaches unsafe temperature levels.
description: Great for bedrooms, work shops, garages and more, this Comfort Zone Flat Panel Radiant Heater helps to quickly warm up cool and drafty spaces. It’s made with halogen heater quartz bulbs, which reflect heat onto nearby objects like the sun and give off a warm glow when in use.

The halogen electric heater features two different heat settings. Switch between them by simply turning a knob at the top of the unit. The same knob also turns the oscillation function on and off. The oscillation setting rotates the quartz heater up to 70 degrees, helping to disperse warmth evenly throughout the room.

This halogen heater has a slim, space-saving flat panel design that fits onto a table, nightstand or on the floor in a small room with ease. Its clean, modern design lines and classic black finish complement a wide range of décor styles with ease.

A tip-over switch automatically turns the heater off if it is knocked over to help prevent fires, while a built-in sensor helps prevent the unit from overheating. A molded handle makes it easy to carry, and the stay-cool handle and housing allow you to safely transport it from room to room.
